regions.full_page: Maloney ... angry (shell-shocked) with Mrs. McMaster for money borrow- ed of him. She came to St. Anthony's devotion last week and promis- ed 1% of anything she might collect on insurence policy she had ne- glected for years - thought absolutely "dead". Last Friday one of her creditors came to monastery lamenting inability to pay his debts because Mrs. McM. did not pay hers. To-day Mrs. M. comes to say she has received four times the amount of her debts from the Ins. Co .... says ... "Miracle". Deo Gr .!
